name: appdirect-pp-mcp
description: Every documented AppDirect marketplace operation in one binary, plus offline sync and billing-reconciliation joins.

appdirect_client_id.title: APPDIRECT_CLIENT_ID
appdirect_client_id.description: Sets APPDIRECT_CLIENT_ID for the AppDirect MCP server.

appdirect_client_secret.title: APPDIRECT_CLIENT_SECRET
appdirect_client_secret.description: Sets APPDIRECT_CLIENT_SECRET for the AppDirect MCP server.

appdirect_oauth_scope.title: APPDIRECT_OAUTH_SCOPE
appdirect_oauth_scope.description: Sets APPDIRECT_OAUTH_SCOPE for the AppDirect MCP server. Required by the generated client for credential refresh or hand-written auth flow.

appdirect_base_url.title: AppDirect API base URL
appdirect_base_url.description: Base URL for the AppDirect API. Leave the prefilled default unless your account uses a different regional or self-hosted host.

appdirect_token_url.title: OAuth2 token URL
appdirect_token_url.description: Token endpoint the client-credentials exchange posts to. Leave the prefilled default unless your tenant uses a different token endpoint.

appdirect_no_config_write.title: Keep credentials off disk
appdirect_no_config_write.description: Set to 1 to keep credentials off disk. The token cache becomes a no-op, so the connector mints a fresh token each run instead of writing one to config.toml. Leave blank for the default cached behaviour.
